title.zh: 零奥扳 · 基础白雷与双后台追击
title.en: Soldier 0 / Orphie / Trigger · Base White Thunder and dual follow-ups

summary.zh: 本站依据原作者与固定技能整理：奥菲丝喷射交零号安比，扳机反向快支回主攻；按白雷、电鸣与协战资源循环，不含潜能觉醒或逐帧最优轴。
summary.en: Site-authored teaching from original guides and fixed skills: Orphie beam and Trigger reverse assists return to Soldier 0; cycle by White Thunder, Thunder and support resources, without Potential Awakening or an optimal frame claim.

conditions.zh: 依据原作者正文与固定Gachabase重组的条件教学；可从0影无专武执行，不是作者逐帧原轴或最高分承诺。
conditions.en: Conditional teaching synthesized from original articles and fixed Gachabase; executable at M0 without signatures, not the author’s frame-perfect rotation or a score guarantee.

conditions.zh: 扳机→奥菲丝→主攻，循环旋转等价；真实快支提示与实际命中优先于表面步骤顺序。
conditions.en: Trigger → Orphie → carry, cyclic rotations equivalent; actual assist prompts and hits take precedence over a nominal step order.

conditions.zh: 准星聚焦由蓄热充能激光命中获得。某成员发动追击只延长该成员自己的效果；不当作全队永久增益。
conditions.en: Zeroed In comes from Heat Charge laser hits. A member’s Aftershock extends only that member’s own effect, not permanent party-wide coverage.

conditions.zh: 扳机提供击破条件，开启奥菲丝额外能力；其25%无视防御仅作用于拥有准星聚焦的成员造成的追击伤害。
conditions.en: Trigger satisfies Orphie’s Stun requirement; the 25% DEF ignore applies only to Aftershock damage by members who have Zeroed In.

conditions.zh: 只用零号安比基础技能。她当前操作时的额外能力才给全队对银星目标的追击增伤；离场不当作持续生效。
conditions.en: Only Soldier 0 base skills are used. Her Additional Ability boosts team Aftershocks against Silver Star while she is active; it is not assumed to persist while inactive.

label.en: Orange · Orphie mechanics and dual-Attack / Aftershock teams (2.2)

label.en: Orange · Trigger sniping and coordinated support (1.6)

label.en: Orange · Soldier 0 White Thunder cycle (1.6)

label.en: Trigger · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 开局
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 绝意与聚焦准备后，安比EX打白雷
objective.en: Prepare Purge and Zeroed In, then build White Thunder with Anby EX

title.zh: 扳机补绝意，放出反向快支
title.en: Refill Purge and produce the reverse assist

input.zh: 长按普攻狙击，确认射击命中；补够绝意后松开，让终结一击命中。
input.en: Hold Basic to snipe and verify hits; release after refilling Purge and land the finishing shot.

trigger.zh: 当前绝意不足以支撑下一轮；有安全射击窗口。已有足量可跳过补充。
trigger.en: Purge is insufficient for the next cycle and a safe sniping window exists; skip replenishment if already sufficient.

complete.zh: 基础每次狙击命中回25、上限100；终结一击命中且25秒冷却已好才出现上一位快支。
complete.en: Base sniper hits restore 25 toward a 100 cap; a finisher hit creates the previous-slot assist only when its 25-second cooldown is ready.

reason.zh: 射击负责资源，松手终结负责交棒；二者不能用按住时间替代。
reason.en: Shots supply resources; the release finisher supplies the handoff. Holding time alone proves neither.

fallback.zh: 未命中就调整瞄准；没有快支则普通切主攻，跳过下一步快支，不计不存在的支援。
fallback.en: Re-aim after misses; without an assist, switch normally to the carry and skip the next assist step.

signal.zh: 终结一击实际命中，上一位主攻快支提示出现。
signal.en: The finishing shot hits and the previous-slot carry assist actually appears.

title.zh: 零号安比按提示快支接手
title.en: Take the carry’s actual Quick Assist

input.zh: 按当前指向主攻的快支提示入场，完成支援攻击。
input.en: Enter through the current carry Quick Assist prompt and finish the assist attack.

trigger.zh: 站位为扳机→奥菲丝→主攻（循环等价）；扳机给上一位、奥菲丝给下一位。
trigger.en: Use Trigger → Orphie → carry cyclically: Trigger assists the previous slot and Orphie the next.

complete.zh: 实际快支完成再继续；奥菲丝加攻需蓄热充能激光命中，Q本身不等于补准星聚焦。
complete.en: Finish the real assist before continuing; Orphie ATK needs a Heat Charge laser hit, not merely an Ultimate.

reason.zh: 两种方向都回到同一主攻；普通切人不算快支，且不自动填主攻资源。
reason.en: Both directions return to the same carry; ordinary switching is not an assist and does not fill carry resources.

fallback.zh: 无提示时普通切入并按实际资源继续；若激光未命中，不假设已取得准星聚焦。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally and follow actual resources; do not assume Zeroed In after a missed laser.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝退到后台后，队友实际攻击且技能就绪才自动追击；≥60能量时可耗30升级，不是免费常驻激光。
label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

title.en: Spend 100 Bottled Heat and hand over during the beam

input.zh: 普通切奥菲丝；蓄炎≥100时长按特殊技，开始喷射出现快支后交主攻。
input.en: Switch normally to Orphie; at 100+ Bottled Heat hold Special, then hand over when the assist appears as firing begins.

trigger.zh: 实际有100蓄炎；目标能被激光命中。开局初始100不代表以后每轮都有。
trigger.en: Actual Bottled Heat is at least 100 and the beam can hit; the initial 100 does not recur every cycle.

complete.zh: 喷射实际开始并出现快支；激光实际命中才取得准星聚焦，切人后让奥菲丝续喷及自动迸射。
complete.en: Confirm firing and the assist; Zeroed In requires the laser to actually hit. Orphie continues firing and then erupts after the switch.

reason.zh: 把蓄炎喷射的动作与主攻输出重叠；此招消耗蓄炎，不能当作消耗60能量。
reason.en: Overlap the Bottled-Heat beam with carry attacks; this spends Heat, not an assumed 60 energy.

fallback.zh: 蓄炎不足先通过实际追击/可用EX积累；没有快支不要提前切断本步，射空则不计加攻。
fallback.en: Build missing Heat through real follow-ups or an available EX; do not claim an assist before it appears, or ATK after a miss.

signal.zh: 喷射开始，实际快支提示指向下一位主攻。
signal.en: Firing begins and the actual next-slot assist points to the carry.

title.zh: 零号安比按提示快支接手
title.en: Take the carry’s actual Quick Assist

input.zh: 按当前指向主攻的快支提示入场，完成支援攻击。
input.en: Enter through the current carry Quick Assist prompt and finish the assist attack.

label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝已启动的激光在交出控制后继续；实际命中/结束状态为准。
label.en: Orphie’s already-started laser continues after handing over control; follow its actual hits and end state.

title.zh: 安比长按EX，命中补满银星
title.en: Hold Anby EX and hit to fill Silver Star

input.zh: EX能量足够时长按特殊技，确保斩击命中当前目标。
input.en: With sufficient EX energy, hold Special and land the slash on the current target.

trigger.zh: 当前白雷不足、需要补充，且有EX能量；不要把点按苍光和长按EX混淆。
trigger.en: White Thunder needs replenishing and EX energy is available; distinguish tap Azure Flash from hold EX.

complete.zh: EX实际命中后确认银星满充、3层白雷；发动但打空不算补满。
complete.en: After an actual EX hit confirm full Silver Star and three White Thunder; activation alone after a miss does not fill it.

reason.zh: 主攻前台制造自己的标记资源；扳机或奥菲丝追击不会在此基础分支自动替她充银星。
reason.en: The active carry creates her own mark resources; teammate Aftershocks do not automatically charge Silver Star in this base branch.

fallback.zh: EX不够就用普攻实际命中蓄标记；射空则重新对准，不强按三次空苍光。
fallback.en: Use actual Basic hits without EX energy; retarget after a miss rather than forcing three empty Azure Flashes.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝退到后台后，队友实际攻击且技能就绪才自动追击；≥60能量时可耗30升级，不是免费常驻激光。
label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

title.zh: 按白雷/电鸣余量点苍光
title.en: Tap Azure Flash according to White Thunder / Thunder resources

input.zh: 目标有白雷时点按特殊技并命中；同一目标继续点按，按实际资源停手。
input.en: Tap Special while the target has White Thunder and land it; continue on the same target only while actual resources permit.

trigger.zh: 目标真实有白雷。0影通常每次命中消耗1层；2影有电鸣时优先替代，但仍要求目标有白雷。
trigger.en: The target actually has White Thunder. M0 normally spends one per hit; M2 Thunder replaces that cost when present, but White Thunder must still exist.

complete.zh: 同一敌人连续触发3次白雷额外伤害才触发雷殛；看余量决定下一刀，不把每轮固定成三刀或九刀。
complete.en: Three consecutive White Thunder extra-damage triggers on the same enemy produce Thunder Smite; choose further slashes from remaining resources, not fixed three/nine counts.

reason.zh: 白雷额外伤害和雷殛属于追击，可维持安比自己的准星聚焦续时；不延长其他成员的效果。
reason.en: White Thunder extra damage and Thunder Smite are Aftershocks and can extend Anby’s own Zeroed In, not another member’s buff.

fallback.zh: 资源不足回普攻/长按EX；目标移动先贴近。不要使用潜能苍光·临界或队友自动充能假设。
fallback.en: Return to Basics/hold EX when empty, and reposition after movement. Do not import Potential Azure Flash variants or teammate auto-charging assumptions.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

prep.zh: 初始100蓄炎可用于第一次喷射；EX开场能量不足就按普攻恢复，不承诺开局满能。
prep.en: Initial 100 Heat funds the first beam; recover with Basics if opening EX energy is insufficient, without assuming full starting energy.

label.zh: 常态循环
label.en: Normal loop

objective.zh: 按标记输出，聚焦缺失再补奥菲丝
objective.en: Attack by mark state and refresh Orphie only when needed

title.en: Build White Thunder through actual Basic hits

input.zh: 打普通攻击，第四段点按或长按可继续突进，按目标的银星充能选择停点。
input.en: Use Basics; tap or hold at stage four for repeated lunges, stopping according to the target’s Silver Star charge.

trigger.zh: 白雷不足且EX/Q未好，或选择用普攻积累资源。
trigger.en: White Thunder is low and EX/Ultimate unavailable, or Basic resource building is preferred.

complete.zh: 每三分之一充能是一层白雷；看到实际白雷再切点按特殊技，不写固定普攻一套必满。
complete.en: Each third of charge becomes one White Thunder; tap Special only after actual stacks appear, not after an assumed full-charge combo.

reason.zh: 保持安比当前操作，让她的额外能力支持银星目标上的全队追击；切走后不计这项前台条件。
reason.en: Keep Anby active so her Additional Ability supports team Aftershocks on the marked target; this active-field condition does not persist merely because she switched away.

fallback.zh: 目标更换就重新看标记；能量回好可改长按EX，敌人攻击优先闪避。
fallback.en: Recheck marks after changing targets; switch to hold EX when ready and dodge incoming attacks first.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。

complete.zh: EX实际命中后确认银星满充、3层白雷；发动但打空不算补满。
complete.en: After an actual EX hit confirm full Silver Star and three White Thunder; activation alone after a miss does not fill it.

reason.zh: 主攻前台制造自己的标记资源；扳机或奥菲丝追击不会在此基础分支自动替她充银星。
reason.en: The active carry creates her own mark resources; teammate Aftershocks do not automatically charge Silver Star in this base branch.

fallback.zh: EX不够就用普攻实际命中蓄标记；射空则重新对准，不强按三次空苍光。
fallback.en: Use actual Basic hits without EX energy; retarget after a miss rather than forcing three empty Azure Flashes.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝退到后台后，队友实际攻击且技能就绪才自动追击；≥60能量时可耗30升级，不是免费常驻激光。
label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

title.zh: 按白雷/电鸣余量点苍光
title.en: Tap Azure Flash according to White Thunder / Thunder resources

input.zh: 目标有白雷时点按特殊技并命中；同一目标继续点按，按实际资源停手。
input.en: Tap Special while the target has White Thunder and land it; continue on the same target only while actual resources permit.

trigger.zh: 目标真实有白雷。0影通常每次命中消耗1层；2影有电鸣时优先替代，但仍要求目标有白雷。
trigger.en: The target actually has White Thunder. M0 normally spends one per hit; M2 Thunder replaces that cost when present, but White Thunder must still exist.

complete.zh: 同一敌人连续触发3次白雷额外伤害才触发雷殛；看余量决定下一刀，不把每轮固定成三刀或九刀。
complete.en: Three consecutive White Thunder extra-damage triggers on the same enemy produce Thunder Smite; choose further slashes from remaining resources, not fixed three/nine counts.

reason.zh: 白雷额外伤害和雷殛属于追击，可维持安比自己的准星聚焦续时；不延长其他成员的效果。
reason.en: White Thunder extra damage and Thunder Smite are Aftershocks and can extend Anby’s own Zeroed In, not another member’s buff.

fallback.zh: 资源不足回普攻/长按EX；目标移动先贴近。不要使用潜能苍光·临界或队友自动充能假设。
fallback.en: Return to Basics/hold EX when empty, and reposition after movement. Do not import Potential Azure Flash variants or teammate auto-charging assumptions.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝退到后台后，队友实际攻击且技能就绪才自动追击；≥60能量时可耗30升级，不是免费常驻激光。
label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

prep.zh: 安比准星聚焦仍充足可跳过喷射与快支两步；蓄炎不足也不能硬开，保持前台积累实际追击。
prep.en: Skip the beam/assist pair when Anby’s Zeroed In has enough duration; do not force it below 100 Heat. Stay active to build actual follow-ups.

prep.zh: 扳机绝意或协战不足时按开局狙击/爆发EX恢复；不把后台追击设为无条件常驻。
prep.en: Recover low Trigger Purge/support through opening snipes or the burst EX; follow-ups are never assumed unconditional or permanent.

label.zh: 输出窗口
label.en: Damage window

objective.zh: 协战支持安比Q/EX分批续白雷
objective.en: Use support for separate Ultimate/EX White Thunder batches

title.en: Land Trigger EX to start coordinated support

input.zh: 普通切扳机；EX能量够时点按并命中，再按上一位主攻的快支提示。
input.en: Switch normally to Trigger; use an available EX, land it, then follow the previous-slot carry prompt.

trigger.zh: 需要补协战，扳机有EX能量；不是单看绝意已满。
trigger.en: Coordinated support needs refreshing and Trigger has EX energy; a full Purge gauge alone is insufficient.

complete.zh: 确认实际命中及协战：本次8秒/4次普通协奏；再次叠加的总上限20秒/10次。
complete.en: Confirm the hit and coordinated support: this EX gives eight seconds/four ordinary follow-ups, stacking only to 20 seconds/ten triggers.

reason.zh: 普通协奏可免绝意与冷却；冥狱依然耗5绝意且有各招式类别的次数限制。
reason.en: Ordinary follow-ups waive Purge and cooldown; Tartarean still costs five Purge and retains its per-category limits.

fallback.zh: EX未好则跳过，用已有绝意正常追击；绝意也低就回狙击补充。不要假装产生快支。
fallback.en: Skip unavailable EX and use existing Purge for normal support; refill by sniping if low. Do not invent an assist prompt.

signal.zh: EX命中后，上一位主攻的快支提示亮起。
signal.en: EX hits and the previous-slot carry Quick Assist prompt appears.

title.zh: 零号安比按提示快支接手
title.en: Take the carry’s actual Quick Assist

input.zh: 按当前指向主攻的快支提示入场，完成支援攻击。
input.en: Enter through the current carry Quick Assist prompt and finish the assist attack.

trigger.zh: 站位为扳机→奥菲丝→主攻（循环等价）；扳机给上一位、奥菲丝给下一位。
trigger.en: Use Trigger → Orphie → carry cyclically: Trigger assists the previous slot and Orphie the next.

complete.zh: 实际快支完成再继续；奥菲丝加攻需蓄热充能激光命中，Q本身不等于补准星聚焦。
complete.en: Finish the real assist before continuing; Orphie ATK needs a Heat Charge laser hit, not merely an Ultimate.

reason.zh: 两种方向都回到同一主攻；普通切人不算快支，且不自动填主攻资源。
reason.en: Both directions return to the same carry; ordinary switching is not an assist and does not fill carry resources.

fallback.zh: 无提示时普通切入并按实际资源继续；若激光未命中，不假设已取得准星聚焦。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally and follow actual resources; do not assume Zeroed In after a missed laser.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.zh: 奥菲丝退到后台后，队友实际攻击且技能就绪才自动追击；≥60能量时可耗30升级，不是免费常驻激光。
label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

title.en: Optional: Anby Ultimate refills Silver Star

input.zh: 安比自己的Q就绪且窗口允许时发动，确保命中同一爆发目标。
input.en: Use Anby’s own ready Ultimate when the window permits and hit the intended target.

trigger.zh: 自身喧响已就绪；已有白雷/电鸣应先判断是否值得补充，避免照表覆盖。
trigger.en: Her own Decibels are ready; consider remaining White Thunder/Thunder before overwriting resources.

complete.zh: Q实际命中补满银星；2影在Q发动时取得6电鸣，上限6，不因打空就宣称目标已有白雷。
complete.en: An actual Ultimate hit fills Silver Star; M2 grants six Thunder on use, capped at six, but a miss does not establish White Thunder on the target.

reason.zh: Q命中与2影发动奖励是两种条件；没有2影不套用电鸣长连段。
reason.en: Ultimate hit and M2 activation rewards have different conditions; M0 does not inherit Thunder-extended sequences.

fallback.zh: Q未好或窗口不足跳过，用现有白雷；Q打空先补标记再苍光，不能只凭电鸣强按。
fallback.en: Skip if unavailable or the window is short and use existing stacks; after a miss establish the mark before Azure Flash instead of relying only on Thunder.

label.zh: 扳机追击仍看绝意、实际命中和冷却；协战只免普通协奏的消耗/冷却，冥狱不免。
label.en: Trigger follow-ups require Purge, actual hits and cooldowns; coordinated support waives only ordinary Harmonizing Shot costs/cooldowns, not Tartarean.

label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

title.zh: 安比长按EX，命中补满银星
title.en: Hold Anby EX and hit to fill Silver Star

input.zh: EX能量足够时长按特殊技，确保斩击命中当前目标。
input.en: With sufficient EX energy, hold Special and land the slash on the current target.

label.en: Once off-field, Orphie follows actual teammate attacks only when ready; at 60+ energy an upgrade can spend 30, not a permanent free beam.

prep.zh: 先确认准星聚焦和目标银星；失衡只是可选输出窗口，不等于扳机挂易伤就已失衡。
prep.en: Check Zeroed In and the target’s Silver Star; Stun is an optional damage window, not an automatic result of Trigger applying her vulnerability.

prep.zh: Q/EX仅在资源与窗口允许时使用；白雷/电鸣尚多时先消耗，不强行覆盖。已有协战可跳前两步。
prep.en: Use Ultimate/EX only when resources and window allow; spend plentiful existing White Thunder/Thunder first. Skip the first two steps with enough existing support.

text.zh: 奥菲丝1影给拥有准星聚焦的角色增伤；专属火抗无视仅对应列出的奥菲丝招式，不变成全队减火抗。
text.en: Orphie M1 boosts damage of agents with Zeroed In; its Fire RES ignore belongs only to the listed Orphie skills, not a team-wide Fire RES reduction.

text.zh: 奥菲丝2影追击回自身喧响有4秒冷却；Q后的加攻属于她自己，不自动给主攻。
text.en: Orphie M2’s own Decibel gain from Aftershocks has a four-second cooldown; her post-Ultimate ATK belongs to herself, not automatically to the carry.

text.zh: 奥菲丝4影把准星聚焦初始持续改为16秒；仍须蓄热充能激光命中，续时仍按各成员自己的追击。
text.en: Orphie M4 changes initial Zeroed In duration to 16 seconds; Heat Charge must still hit and extensions still follow each member’s own Aftershocks.

text.zh: 扳机1影提高绝意上限与获得效率、缩短普通协奏冷却；协战次数与冥狱开销仍按实际技能。
text.en: Trigger M1 raises Purge capacity/gain and reduces ordinary follow-up cooldown; coordinated counts and Tartarean costs retain their actual skill rules.

text.zh: 扳机2影由发动追击+1猎眸、发动狙击终结一击+2，最多4层；普通狙击四枪不等于直接叠满。
text.en: Trigger M2 gains one Gaze from an Aftershock and two from the sniper finisher, up to four; four ordinary sniper shots do not directly max it.

text.zh: 嚣枪喧焰需要她自己的火属性追击伤害，3秒最多叠1层、最多2层；不会给主攻提供该音擎的防御无视。
text.en: Bellicose Blaze needs her own Fire Aftershock damage, at most one stack per three seconds and two stacks total; it does not grant the carry its DEF ignore.

text.zh: 索魂影眸由电属性追击实际命中挂减防；魂锁另要求扳机不是当前操作角色，同一招式最多1层。
text.en: Spectral Gaze applies DEF reduction on actual Electric Aftershock hits; Spirit Lock additionally requires Trigger to be inactive, at most one stack per skill use.

text.zh: 安比1影EX实际命中额外触发3次白雷伤害，不消耗原白雷；不是所有点按特殊技都能免费触发。
text.en: Anby M1 adds three White Thunder damage triggers on an actual EX hit without consuming the existing stacks; ordinary tap Specials do not gain this free trigger.

text.zh: 安比2影Q发动给6电鸣；苍光命中有白雷目标时改耗电鸣。电鸣用完再耗白雷，以当前实际余量延续；不包含潜能苍光·临界提速。
text.en: Anby M2 gives six Thunder on Ultimate use. Azure Flash hits on a White Thunder target spend Thunder first, then White Thunder. Extend according to actual remaining resources; Potential-variant speedups are excluded.

text.zh: 安比6影触发6次白雷额外伤害后追加电磁涡流；1/2影会影响触发节奏，不能固定说每按6次键一次。
text.en: Anby M6 triggers its vortex after six White Thunder extra-damage triggers. M1/M2 change the cadence, so six button presses are not the universal trigger.

text.zh: 牺牲洁纯由自己的普攻/特殊技/追击实际命中积累独立计时层数；3层才有电伤提升，不因进场就算满层。
text.en: Severed Innocence builds independently timed stacks on her own Basic/Special/Aftershock hits; its Electric damage bonus requires three stacks, not merely entering the field.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.零号安比按提示快支接手: 看到安比快支提示再入场

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.可选：安比Q补银星: 可选：安比开终结技，命中同一目标

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切奥菲丝；蓄炎≥100时长按特殊技，开始喷射出现快支后交主攻。: 奥菲丝普通入场且蓄炎至少100时，长按特殊技开始喷射。看到主攻的快速支援提示再交棒。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切扳机；EX能量够时点按并命中，再按上一位主攻的快支提示。: 扳机普通入场后，能量够时点按强化特殊技并命中；看到指向主攻的快速支援提示再交棒。

ROTATION_CONTEXT_TITLES.EX能量足够时长按特殊技，确保斩击命中当前目标。: 长按特殊技发动强化特殊技

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1381: 用普攻命中积白雷；需要补银星且能量够时长按强化特殊技，有资源再续特殊技。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.130100006: 蓄炎达到100时长按特殊技，完成本次喷射
